display.headline: Mechanics as printed: stockholders may request repurchase of all or any portion of shares monthly, company may repurchase all, some or…
display.plain: Mechanics as printed: stockholders may request repurchase of all or any portion of shares monthly, company may repurchase all, some or none in its discretion.

3.2.quote: Shares are repurchased at a price equal to the transaction price on the applicable repurchase date, subject to any early repurchase deduction
3.2.section: Item 5 - Share repurchase plan (mechanics, priority, transaction-price rule)
3.2.value: Mechanics as printed: stockholders may request repurchase of all or any portion of shares monthly; company may repurchase all, some or none in its discretion. Price = transaction price on the applicable repurchase date (generally prior month's NAV), subject to any early repurchase deduction (95% of transaction price if held <1 year). Proration priority when repurchasing less than all: (1) death/qualifying-disability requests in full up to $5.0M/month (excess honored in date-of-death order, remainder pro rata), (2) requests that would leave an account below $2,500 in full, (3) all other shares pro rata. If the transaction price is not made available by the 10th business day before the last business day of the month (or is changed after), no requests are accepted that month and holders must resubmit. Funding: cash and cash equivalents, borrowings including lines of credit (10-K risk factors: lines of credit used 'to fund repurchases'), offering proceeds and asset-sale proceeds per the liquidity discussion. Exemptions differ by holder: repurchases from the Advisor of management-fee shares are made outside the plan and are NOT subject to the monthly/quarterly limitations or the Early Repurchase Deduction; repurchases from the Special Limited Partner of performance-participation shares are exempt from the Early Repurchase Deduction only - they remain subject to the monthly/quarterly limitations and receive no priority.
